summary: The human's revision comment indicates a bug where item creation fails due to an incorrect requirement for an 'id' field in the model. This plan modifies the Item model to remove the client-supplied id field and update all related backend and frontend code to use MongoDB's native _id instead. The changes ensure that the id field is no longer required during creation, fixing the validation error that occurred on the second item creation.

files.rationale: Remove the required id field from the Item model as per the human revision comment. The id field should not be required since MongoDB will generate the _id field automatically.
Update the API route handler to remove any reference to the client-supplied id field during item creation and updates, ensuring that only MongoDB's auto-generated _id is used.
Update the frontend page to remove any handling of the id field in forms and item displays, since the id is now managed by MongoDB.
Update the API service functions to not expect or send a client-supplied id field, aligning with the backend changes.
